_comment: REFERENCE SHAPE — an egress-proxy activation observation (the optional agent-egress-control component; see ../../../loom/references/agent-egress-control.md). CrabTrap is one instance of the role; the record shape is vendor-neutral. This example satisfies HG-0011: the bypass test proves the CHOKEPOINT, not the policy — an agent runtime with the proxy variables unset got no route out. HG-0012's egress allow-list needs its OWN record, whose bypass_test is a denied retrieval source during a build/eval run. observed_at / tested_at / signature are ADOPT placeholders: a real record is produced against your live gateway and signed by an observer identity outside the coding agent's write authority.

observation.deployment: onshore, inside the institution boundary (NOT a managed PaaS — HG-0011 is a residency decision)
observation.agent_identity: agent-loom-delivery holds its own gateway token and policy
observation.audit_sink: postgres, append-only role; the agent identity has no write grant
observation.network_policy: default-deny egress on the agent's subnet; the proxy is the sole exception

bypass_test.attempted: outbound HTTPS from the agent runtime to an ALLOWED host with HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY unset — the route-around, not the policy
